in_sanskrit.name: Adivin
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Knowledgeable, Seer, Prophet
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Adivin एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Adivin is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ada' (knowledge, wisdom) and 'Vin' (seer, prophet). This name is given to a child who is believed to possess extraordinary wisdom and the ability to foresee future events. Adivin is a revered and respected name in Hindu tradition, associated with spiritual leaders, sages, and prophets.
